top_signals.title: Fed Faces a Different Kind of Inflation Problem, Says Kaplan
top_signals.summary: Robert Kaplan, Goldman Sachs Vice Chairman and former Dallas Fed President, says the Fed must look beyond headline data to understand what is driving inflation. He points to high diesel prices and other structural pressures that spread through the economy while warning that aggressive rate hikes could damage already-weak sectors. Kaplan explains why policymakers may need to take a slower and more deliberate approach. He speaks with Bloomberg's Tom Keene and Paul Sweeney. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: How Russia Sees the World Now
top_signals.summary: Dmitry Adamsky, an expert on Russian security and Russian nuclear deterrence strategy at Harvard and Reichman Universities, examines a large-scale shift in Russia’s strategic thinking over the past year, centered around the view that Europe, rather than the United States, is now Russia’s primary geopolitical rival and adversary, and looking at the consequences of this shift for US efforts to end the war in Ukraine.
